title: Host a District Walking Tour
intro: You have invited your guests to walk a part of the district with you. Everyone is in comfortable shoes, and everyone is watching where you take them.
prompt_2: Along the way the conversation turns to policy. What do you talk about?
prompt_3: At the end of the walk someone asks what you will do about it. What do you promise?

title: Host a Dinner
intro: The table is set and the guests are arriving. You have chosen the menu yourself, and each guest will notice what is, and is not, on it.
prompt_2: Over dinner the talk turns to policy. What do you bring up?
prompt_3: Over tea someone asks what you will do about it. What do you promise?
